notes: Swarm Sticker (STICK) is a plain community token for the IMD swarm sticker pack. SwarmSticker takes no constructor arguments and mints 1,000,000,000 tokens with 18 decimals once to msg.sender. It has no transfer fees, post-launch minting, or owner powers. No application contracts or initialization calls are required. The pool pairs native ETH with STICK at a 0.3% fee. initialPrice is provenance only: with ETH as currency0, sqrt(totalSupply / initialMarketCapWei) * 2^96 equals the recorded value. The deployer derives the opening price from economics.initialMarketCapWei and token.totalSupply.
